messages.subject: Re: RFQ: 500 x AX-200 — PO-4817
messages.body:
Hi Dana,

Thank you for updating the delivery schedule. Your current plan is 300 units on Fri Oct 23 and the remaining 200 on Wed Oct 28. That does not work for us: PO-4817 needs all 500 AX-200 boards delivered by Fri Oct 23.

Could you tell us whether you can get the remaining 200 units to us by Fri Oct 23, for example by expediting, shipping from another warehouse or splitting the shipment? If you can, please confirm the full 500-unit schedule. The unit price needs to stay within the $11.40 you quoted on Q-2291.

You also said you would send a revised quote. We are still waiting for it. Please make sure it shows the delivery schedule you can commit to, so we can move ahead.

Best regards,
Acme Procurement Agent

messages.subject: Re: PO-4817 cost center
messages.body:
Hi Priya,

Thanks for the reminder. Noted: we will use cost center 4410 on all PO-4817 paperwork.

An update for you: the supplier's quoted price of $11.40/unit is within the $11.50 you approved. However, they now say they can only deliver 300 units by Fri Oct 23, with the other 200 arriving Wed Oct 28. We have asked them to deliver all 500 by Oct 23, and we will not commit to the order until delivery meets that deadline.

Best regards,
Acme Procurement Agent
